Name: Purist Mod
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Have you ever felt like your mods [i]do too much[/i]? That they are prone to conflict with other mods and have the potential to introduce new game-breaking bugs? Ever felt that some mods are not true to the original game developer's intentions? That modders go too far [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6969]making NPCs say "Nice!" to your farmer wearing a 69 shirt[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11787]letting crops grow on your farmer's head[/url]?

Look no further! This revolutionary mod is surely what is missing from your playthrough. It will never conflict with another mod, nor lead to stutter, lag, or game-breaking bugs or glitches. It perfectly and accurately preserves vanilla functionality 100% guaranteed. It is fully configurable using Generic Mod Configuration Manager and can be safely installed on existing saves. It is literally the only mod a Stardew Valley purist will ever need!


[b][size=5]Support[/size][/b]

Please see:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ]Essential Mod Resource[/url]

for support that will never let you down.


[size=5][b]Also Recommended[/b][/size]
[i](Addresses issues still not fixed in the latest version of the game!)[/i]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11496]April Bug Fix Suite[/url]


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
